notes: The same entity as Home Assistant 2026.10.4 sends it with unit_system us_customary: google_weather.json's values fed to Home Assistant's WeatherEntity as native values in the units its attributes state (°C, hPa, km/h, km, mm), state and forecasts read back through the weather component with hass.config.units set to US_CUSTOMARY_SYSTEM. Temperatures come back as whole °F (ints: outside °C the weather entity rounds to whole degrees), pressure in inHg, wind in mph, visibility in mi and precipitation in in, each to 2 decimals; humidity, bearings, conditions, datetimes and every other field are as in the metric file. The metric file's notes follow; their numbers are metric. The test does not freeze the clock, so now is the first hourly entry. Core's fixtures are trimmed to one daily, one hourly and two twice-daily entries. Changes for realism (test-data artefacts): the daily and twice-daily fixtures start five days after the hourly one, so both are moved back five days to start today (the day half began at 07:00 local, 15:00Z, before now at 15:00 local); today's high (daily and the day half) is raised from 13.3 to 14.4, and its feels-like from 13.3 to 14.0, so it is not below the 13.7 C now.
